Position Title: Fitter 
No. of positions: 02
Location: 138 Dunheved Cct, St Marys NSW 2760
Reports to: Operations Head / Supervisor
Annual salary: $80,000 .00 -  $85,000.00 plus Super 

As a Fitter, your main duties and responsibilities include: 

•	Study technical drawings, specifications and job instructions to determine suitable materials, methods, sequence of operations and machine settings.
•	Fit, assemble and align fabricated metal parts and subassemblies to construct or repair machines and mechanical equipment.
•	Check fabricated and assembled metal parts for accuracy, clearance and fit using precision measuring instruments (micrometer, vernier caliper, gauges) etc.
•	Perform precision fitting, levelling and alignment of machines and engineering components.
•	Perform mechanical cutting, machining and general fabrication tasks using hand tools, power tools and fixed/moveable machinery.
•	Carry out shutdown, isolation and lock-out procedures on machines and equipment prior to maintenance or repair work.
•	Use load-shifting equipment (cranes, hoists, forklifts) safely to move materials, machinery and components.
•	Set up, adjust and operate machining tools and equipment for cutting, grinding, drilling, boring and shaping metal stock and castings. 
•	Diagnose faults in mechanical plant, equipment and components, and identify worn or defective parts.
•	Repair, replace and overhaul worn or faulty mechanical components, bearings, drives and transmission assemblies.
•	Install, maintain and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems and their components, including cutting, threading and bending pipes and lines.

•	Test and adjust mechanical parts and assemblies after repair to confirm correct operation and performance.
•	Interpret and apply relevant Australian standards, workplace procedures and manufacturer specifications.

•	Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade – Fitter (General) preferred.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Insurance Loss Adjustor to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. This is a full-time position located in all areas of Darwin NT.

The primary purpose of this role is to be responsible for the timely completion of accurate and comprehensive quotes for accident repairs on vehicles. You will apply your knowledge of motor vehicles and your skills with computers whilst interacting with a range of people. 

Reporting to the Centre Manager this role will work within our large network of repair facilities and you will be provided with stability and opportunity.

- Providing excellent customer service to clients and work providers
- Accurately quote vehicles in a timely manner and in accordance with average repair cost targets and insurer/company procedures
- Complete quotes as required onsite, off-site and online
- Processing vehicles onsite by carrying out vehicle arrival inspections, including mapping and imaging
- Manage parts for repairs to ensure timely arrival and cost effectiveness as required
- Manage suppliers to ensure additional work is recorded and authorised in a timely manner
- Assist with production management of the centre where required
- Ensure vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition
- Hand over completed repairs to customers

- Proven experience with AudaNet would be highly desirable
- Ibody experience desirable but not necessary

- Highly professional and personable
- Strong systems experience and competent computer abilities
- Excel an advantage but not a necessary

- Ability to meet strict deadlines
- Ability to problem solve and excellent accuracy and attention to detail
- Able to work effectively and collaboratively with the team
- Strong commitment to work in a safe manner
- High attention to detail
- Be reliable, punctual & hardworking

We are leaders in the repair industry and offer
-Team environment
-Ongoing training
-Career opportunity
-Latest tools, equipment and process
-Great opportunity to earn big $$$ for competent and efficient tradespeople

Full-Time Position
We are seeking a highly motivated Retail Manager to join our team at SA & SMJ Pty Ltd. 
Building on an outstanding reputation as a rural and regional pharmacy group, SA & SMJ Pty Ltd is further diversifying and strengthening its business activities through its disability aids and equipment and non-prescription goods and services divisions. •	promote the sale of disability aids within our existing regional pharmacy network having particular regard to disabled children and teenagers; and

•	drive improvement in sales of non-prescription goods and services such as vitamins, cosmetics, confectionary, weight loss powders, and perfumes

•	Developing and implementing sales, marketing, and promotional strategies to increase revenue and customer engagement with our disability aids and equipment and non-prescription divisions 
•	Monitoring stock levels, purchasing requirements, and inventory control across all retail locations
•	Analysing sales performance and preparing reports on retail and online trading activities
•	Managing pricing, product presentation, merchandising, and promotional displays
•	Coordinating online product listings, digital promotions, and customer order fulfilment processes
•	Supervising and training retail staff to ensure high standards of customer service
•	Liaising with suppliers and service providers regarding stock supply, product availability, and promotional activities
•	Maintaining customer satisfaction by responding to customer enquiries and resolving complaints effectively
Skills, Experience and Qualifications
To be considered for this position, applicants must possess:
•	At least 1–2 years of relevant retail management experience
•	Strong understanding of retail sales, stock control, merchandising, and customer service practices
•	Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple retail outlets
•	Strong computer literacy and experience with retail point-of-sale and inventory systems
•	Qualification at diploma level or above preferably in a field related to retail management, disability services, child related services or a combined field of study
•	Hold or willing to obtain a NSW working with children check and Australian Federal Police clearance
Sales and Marketing:
•	Develop and execute effective marketing strategies to promote retail sales
•	Analyze market trends and customer preferences to identify opportunities for growth
•	Set retail pricing

•	Provide outstanding customer support to retail customers in person and via email, chat, and phone
•	Address customer inquiries, concerns, and complaints in a timely and professional manner
•	Ensure that retail customer feedback is collected and used to improve products and services
•	Work towards building long-lasting customer relationships and brand loyalty

Applicants should submit a current resume together with a brief cover letter outlining their relevant experience and suitability for the role.
